main_body: A flat sand ground patch (4x3 tiles) in pale tan with sparse darker and lighter speckles, a small grey stone and a pink flower/cross mark. It is a terrain tile, not a standing object.
top_band: none (flat ground texture, no standing object; the column scan shows only sand speckle runs L=169-220)
evidence: Terrain ground patch seen from above. It has no standing volume, so the top/front contract does not apply. It is a uniform sand surface with speckles and no false vertical faces or elevation drawing. Kind terrain matches.

style.evidence: The sand uses only 3 tones (#c9a666, #e2c584, #f1dca2) plus a few accent pixels, 11 colours in total. The median is 3 colours per tile against 26 for the reference grass and 7 for the paving. The speckles are sparse and scattered with no clumped grain, ripples or pebble shading, so the surface reads thin next to the grass reference. Flat-fill coverage is 0%, so the speckle does break up the surface, but the ramp is shallow. There is no outline, which is fine for ground. The density gap to the references is large.
